notes: Libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder (1791). Words as printed in the Edition Peters vocal score, which the app follows where it differs from the libretto: "bald dringen wir in Tempel ein" (the libretto has "im Tempel"), "Doch Fürstin, halte Wort, erfülle," with commas, "muss" and "grosse" with ss, "Wiederhall", "Feuersgluth", "mächt'gem", "Erd'", "unsrer", "zernichtet" and "gestürzet". The Ladies sing "Ihr Kind soll deine Gattin sein" where the Queen sings "Mein Kind"; the Third Lady repeats "soll deine Gattin". Repeats of the music are written out as sung: "Nur stille" and "bald dringen wir in Tempel ein" by Monostatos and then the women; "Dort wollen wir sie überfallen" twice (Monostatos the second time "überfallen" only); "Dir, grosse Königin der Nacht" twice. The Queen does not sing "Dir, grosse Königin der Nacht, sei unsrer Rache Opfer gebracht!"; Monostatos and the three Ladies sing it to her, kneeling. The Queen and the First and Second Ladies sing in unison on one printed staff from bar 65; each singer has her own line here. IPA follows sung German stage diction: final -er, -ern as [ɐ]; the prefixes er-, ver-, zer- with [ɛr]; r elsewhere rolled or flipped; ch as [ç] after front vowels and [x] after back vowels; glottal stops [ʔ] before initial vowels; final b d g devoiced.
